title: Market strip: live quote tiles with direction colour instead of crowded charts
changes: The TradingView charts were removed; SPX and BTC are now tiles with the current value and the daily change, green with an up arrow or red with a down arrow
S&P 500 comes from Yahoo Finance (direct, then public CORS proxies); BTC from Binance with Coinbase as fallback; refreshed every two minutes while the tab is visible
No third-party widget scripts load any more
